stories.headline: WIZ KHALIFA'S SENTENCE RESET
stories.verified_update: The Bucharest Court of Appeal voided Wiz Khalifa's nine-month Romanian prison judgment and execution warrant on Nov. 3; DIICOT's appeal is set for rehearing on Nov. 12.

sources.title: Răsturnare de situație pentru Wiz Khalifa
CAB a anulat condamnarea la închisoare primită de rapperul Wiz Khalifa; procesul se rejudecă

stories.headline: EMINEM'S TRACK HITS THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL
stories.verified_update: Abdul El-Sayed's final Michigan Senate ad uses Eminem's Not Afraid; Eminem's representative said the campaign did not reach out, so the appearance is not a confirmed endorsement.

sources.title: Eminem's Not Afraid Used in Abdul El-Sayed Campaign Ad
Eminem's Not Afraid used in El-Sayed Election Day campaign ad

stories.headline: BELLY GANG LOCKS IN THE NEXT MOVE
stories.verified_update: Belly Gang Kushington announced GOOD DOPE SELL ITSELF for Nov. 13 and his first multi-city WTF GOIN Tour, turning a breakout year into a larger album-and-live test.

stories.headline: WU-TANG TAKES THANKSGIVING
stories.verified_update: Wu-Tang Clan will headline the Detroit Lions' Nov. 26 Thanksgiving halftime show against the Chicago Bears, with Eminem and Paul Rosenberg producing and selecting the talent.

stories.headline: GTA VI PRELOADS AHEAD OF LAUNCH
stories.verified_update: Rockstar says GTA VI digital pre-load begins Nov. 10 and the console install requires about 212 GB before the Nov. 19 launch.
